a_arbitrator_dispatch_inputs.meaning: DispatchArbitrator.tick receives p_dispatch_required_mw minus fuel-cell/diesel achieved output, dt_seconds, BESS target, per-unit ceilings and SoC floors.

b_grid_exchange.meaning: Islanded mode sets grid exchange to zero; grid-tied mode applies grid_import_limit_mw to import and adds allowed imports to p_generation_mw.

c_soc_floor.meaning: soc_floor_mwh computes diesel, configured normal-depth and D2-R bridge terms; floor is their maximum.

d_absorb_surplus.meaning: Current charging branch is turbine surplus absorption; it is not a grid-import charging path.

e_efficiency_and_charge_rate.charge_acceptance_ceiling_formula: sum(min(unit rated_mw, remaining usable_mwh / dt_hours)) for non-tripped BESS units
e_efficiency_and_charge_rate.charge_power_limit: BessConfig.rated_mw; no separate scenario charge-rate field found
e_efficiency_and_charge_rate.scenario_charge_price_is_accounting_only: bess_charge_price_override_per_mwh is a billing input; no physical charge-rate parameter found in the scenario schema.

single_grid_mode_branch_location.meaning: One grid-mode branch within DispatchArbitrator.tick, adjacent to the existing island_mode read and the central BESS discharge/surplus-absorption decision, keeps the existing islanded path as the other branch.
